name: cppl-vscode
description: Client for cppl-lsp, the C++L language server. Registers the cppl language and starts cppl-lsp over stdio.

cppl.serverPath.description: Path to the cppl-lsp executable. Defaults to build/dev/bin/cppl-lsp relative to the workspace root.

cppl.clangPath.description: Clang driver executable cppl-lsp uses to preprocess and semantically check documents (forwarded as cppl-lsp --clang). Defaults to cppl-lsp's own default.

cppl.clangArguments.description: Extra arguments forwarded to Clang for every document (include paths, defines, -std=), forwarded as repeated cppl-lsp --clang-arg.
